# GitHub Copilot Code Review Instructions

## Review Standards

- Ensure all documentation is accurate, complete, and relevant to the supported technologies (Active Directory, Entra ID, Exchange Online, MIM 2016, Sectigo Certificate Manager, Microsoft 365).
- Check for consistent use of terminology and formatting.
- Verify that all code blocks are fenced and use the correct language identifier (e.g., powershell, cmd).
- Confirm that references are authoritative and up-to-date.
- Ensure troubleshooting steps and best practices are included where appropriate.

## Formatting Checklist

- Headings and lists are surrounded by blank lines.
- Tables are used for configuration and comparison data.
- All markdown passes linting and renders correctly in Docfx.

## Example Review Comments

- "Please add a reference to Microsoft documentation for this procedure."
- "Use fenced code blocks for all command-line examples."
- "Expand troubleshooting section for common errors."
